title: Neither Name Nor Face
narration_slice: that the Valyrians did not discover the art of taming dragons on their own - because dragons had already been mastered ages earlier in the Shadow beyond Asshai. According to this Asshai'i tradition, a people so ancient that surviving memory preserves neither their name nor their unmasked faces first bent dragons
locations: LOC-ESS-003 Asshai interior and northern wall (0461-0465); first entry into the Shadow beyond Asshai (0466-0470, scene refs still carry the stale LOC-VAL-001 tag)
creature_refs: none yet - 0470 is the first frame where a dragon should appear in the Shadow, and it is unrendered
asshai_lock: cyclopean jointless black stone, no ashlar, no capital, no base, no cornice, no square pavers; blood-red shadowbinder lanterns only; bowed hoods hanging below the crown of the head
shadow_lock: The Shadow beyond Asshai is NOT built and NOT inhabited, and it must never look like a civilisation. Raw sheared black rock, glassy in patches, scored as if by heat, totally untooled. No doorways, no walls, no stairs, no statues, no idols, no idols' faces. Black gravel and wind-rippled ash. Flat sourceless grey-green gloom with no directional shadow and no sun. Distance is conveyed by the mist thickening, never by atmospheric perspective on a light source.
the_unmasked_face_problem: The narration's phrase 'unmasked faces' is the most dangerous line in the episode: it invites the model to render a face. Rule adopted for the remaining Shadow frames - the people are so ancient that memory preserves no faces, so the camera must never be in a position to have one: figures are distant silhouettes, seen from behind, or bowed under hoods that hang past the crown. Every Shadow prompt negates face, mask, eyes, mouth, nose and profile by name.

scenes.visual_beat: Towering vertical scale composition — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 24mm up a fissure-stair: not a built staircase but a natural cleft in the black stone worn by centuries of feet into uneven slick ledges climbing out of sight. Walls are single unbroken planes with no joints and no ornament. One small bowed figure climbs away from the camera, hood low, one pale hand flat on the wall for balance, closed scrolls under the other arm. One red lantern on an iron spike throws the only colour; the top of the stair is absolute dark. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Macro environmental / material texture insert — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 85mm macro at a grazing angle on the worn edge of a black stone shelf. Greasy light-drinking basalt pitted with vesicles, and along the top edge a broad shallow depression worn smooth and slightly polished by generations of palms, paler and silkier than the raw rock. Grit and a few hairs caught in the hollow. Nothing is cut or written into the stone - the only record here is wear. A low red rake from the right picks out the shine; the deep stone dissolves. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Intimate close-up detail / expression beat — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 85mm close-up of a seated archivist in a black stone niche. The head is bowed so steeply that the coarse hood hangs past the crown and the entire head becomes a cloth void - verified at 2x, there is no eye, nose, mouth or mask plane, only shadow inside the hood and a few strands of fine grey hair at its edge. Both hands rest on a closed, cord-bound, uncracked scroll. A dull red rim along the shoulder is the only light. Privately unreadable. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Extreme close-up tactile / light study — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 100mm macro on the rolled end of a closed scroll filling the frame: cracked, furred, hardened hide, black cord knotted twice and still tied, and a BLANK thumb-pressed wax seal. Verified at 4x - the seal carries no impression, no stamp and no symbol of any kind. Fine grey dust along the upper curve; matte basalt beneath that eats the light. A weak yellow-grey tallow edge at the upper left, red filling the shadow behind. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Transitional wide horizon / bridge framing — Candlelit Asshai archives challenging Valyria's boast
scenes.qc_note: 40mm over a thick jointless parapet at the northern wall. Beyond the worn stone edge the ground falls to a bare ash plain, and the pale grey-green mist does not thin - it rises and hardens into the Shadow Mountains, one unbroken mass of black with no detail, no summit line and no visible distance, filling the right half of the frame. Nothing moves. No light source exists. Reframed 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Low-angle monumental architectural / geological framing — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 28mm from the ground at the mouth of the black pass. Two colossal walls of raw sheared rock rise and converge overhead, glassy in patches and scored as if by heat, close to the camera and untooled. No doorway has been built - the walls simply meet the ground. Black gravel and ash drift against them. No footprints, no path. Flat sourceless gloom with no directional shadow, going to absolute black within a hundred paces. Deep focus, monumental, and completely without a builder. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Over-the-shoulder depth perspective — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 40mm over the shoulder into the pass. The foreground hood is a soft black mass on the left third, seen from behind with nothing of a face or profile. Far up the gravel, in sharp focus, three hooded figures stand in a loose line facing the dark - distant enough to be shapes only, their number all that can be read off them. Behind them the pass simply becomes black. Flat grey-green gloom, no lantern. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Deep-focus wide atmospheric composition — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 28mm wide from a low rise of broken rock over the ash floor of the pass. Four small robed figures cross from left to right in single file, widely spaced, hooded and low-headed, walking without hurry toward the far cliff. Black gravel and wind-rippled ash to the base of two sheared cliffs; no path, no wall, no marker, no structure anywhere. Flat gloom so the figures cast no defined shadow and their feet are lost in the ash haze. Scale is the subject: people are the smallest thing in the country. Full-bleed.

scenes.visual_beat: Ultra-wide establishing vista — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: 24mm ultra-wide from the lip of a sheer drop into a vast high valley of black broken rock and wind-rippled ash. Two colossal cliff walls frame it and run away into distance; the mist does not thin, it thickens until there is no horizon at all, only mist becoming darkness becoming the mass of the Shadow. Far below, seven tiny robed marks cross the floor in single file, evenly spaced, walking west. Their number is the only readable thing about them. Reframed 12-755.

scenes.visual_beat: Medium close-up atmospheric focal beat — Disputed legend: nameless Shadow masters teaching Valyrians
scenes.qc_note: **THE CLAIM GETS A BODY.** 50mm at chest height in the Shadow: the head and neck of a vast black dragon bent LOW, muzzle almost on the rock, only head and neck in frame so the limb count cannot go wrong - one head, one neck, nothing else of the animal. Twin swept-back obsidian horns flat to the skull, one lowered brass-gold slit eye, a thread of black smoke from the nostril. In the left foreground, soft: the back of a coarse hood and a bare pale forearm, the hand resting flat on the muzzle. **No face in frame and none possible.** Grey-green gloom gives the scales no shine. Cropped 12-728.
